'''''Phragmipedium longifolium''''' is a species of [[orchid]] ranging from [[Costa Rica]] to [[Ecuador]].'' Phragmipedium longifolium'' is a herb found natively in the coastal and Andean regions of Ecuador, among other surrounding countries.<ref>Dodson, C. H. &
Dodson, P.M., 1980, Icones Plantarum Tropicarum. http://www.tropicos.org/Name/23500475?projectid=2</ref>
